name: Trace a catalogue record from discovery to provenance

messages.content: Search the page catalogue for the flood-monitoring API, inspect its exact resource record, then show the packaged provenance for that record.

name: Explore and compare evidence for the new-child answer

messages.content: Show the evidence foundations for the registering-a-birth claim in the new-child starting-points answer, then compare that claim with the Child Benefit claim.

name: Minimise context sent to a catalogue search

messages.content: My personal circumstances are private and irrelevant to this page. Search only for flooding, return at most 3 records, and do not put any other context into the tool call.

name: Do not call a catalogue tool for an unrelated calculation

messages.content: What is 2 plus 2? Do not use the government catalogue.
